definitions.gloss: sweet red-bean soup with mochi or rice dumplings
definitions.explanation: A hot, sweet soup of azuki bean paste served with grilled mochi or small rice-flour dumplings. Usually said with the polite prefix: お{汁粉|しるこ}.

examples.japanese: お{汁粉|しるこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お{汁粉|しるこ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{恋|こい}しい→恋しい：03055_koishii⟧。
examples.english: On cold days I crave oshiruko.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鏡開|かがみびら}き→鏡開き：25599_kagamibiraki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{鏡餅|かがみもち}→鏡餅：19469_kagamimochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{割|わ}って→割る：02334_waru⟧お{汁粉|しるこ}にした。
examples.english: On kagami-biraki day we broke up the New Year mochi and made oshiruko.

notes:
A winter sweet, traditionally eaten at ⟦{鏡開|かがみびら}き→鏡開き：25599_kagamibiraki⟧ (January 11), when the New Year's mochi is broken and cooked. Canned お{汁粉|しるこ} is sold hot in vending machines.

- ⟦ぜんざい→ぜんざい：20244_zenzai⟧: also a sweet red-bean dish with mochi. In the Kansai region, {汁粉|しるこ} is made with smooth bean paste and ⟦ぜんざい→ぜんざい：20244_zenzai⟧ with whole beans; in the Kanto region, {汁粉|しるこ} covers both soups and ⟦ぜんざい→ぜんざい：20244_zenzai⟧ is a thick paste with almost no liquid
- ⟦{餡子|あんこ}→餡子：08654_anko⟧: sweet bean paste, the base of {汁粉|しるこ}
